The '''antique Twi'lek pots''' were a collection of ancient valuable and antique pots made by early [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] civilizations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. During the [[Rise of the Empire era]] they were held by the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]] and stored in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] archives on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. At some point an anonymous wealthy client from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] hired the [[Blank Look Gang]] to steal them from the [[Museum/Legends|museum]] since they weren't on display and it was felt they wouldn't be missed. Several Blankers attempted the robbery including [[Hewpaj]] and [[Urnon Mossu]] and reprogrammed a [[ASP-7 labor droid/Legends|ASP-7 labor droid]] to bring the pots to the museum's landing platform and then drop them to the waiting criminals below. However several [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] were hired to watch for just such a heist and chase the thieves as they fled eventually capturing them after they crashed, the pots were very likely destroyed or heavily damaged in the process.
